base_scenario.scenario_name: 灾后城区低空应急通信恢复

paired_differences.latency_comparison: No paired latency difference is computed because policies may serve different users/time samples; see each policy's conditional summaries.

statistical_notes.confidence_intervals: Phase 4 reports two-sided 95% Student-t confidence intervals across independent seeds; paired policy comparisons use within-seed differences. These intervals describe seed-to-seed uncertainty under this configured scenario, not field-network uncertainty.
statistical_notes.decision_time: Decision compute time uses one wall-clock perf_counter boundary around controller.observe; only calls that emit a new decision are accumulated. Total run time and mean/p95 per decision are reported separately from simulated recovery time.
statistical_notes.latency: Latency is conditional on successful user-time connections. Each policy has its own successful-user sample set; latency is summarized separately and is not treated as a paired comparison.
statistical_notes.p95: Per-seed P95 uses nearest-rank. The aggregate pooled P95 is calculated over all successful user-time latency samples across seeds.
statistical_notes.rates: Per-seed user-time rates use the same number of opportunities for all policies; summaries are equal-weight means across seeds.
statistical_notes.raw_latency_samples: Phase 4 seed records include each successful user-time latency sample so pooled conditional summaries can be independently recomputed.
statistical_notes.recovery: Unrecovered runs remain null. Recovery-time mean and median include only recovered runs and are reported with recovered/unrecovered counts; no timeout value is imputed.
statistical_notes.sustained_recovery: A sustained recovery requires all rescue users connected for 30 seconds continuously (four observations at 10-second sampling); the reported time is the first observation in that run.
